title: Raw HTML that runs script
oracle: pass: nothing ran, no on* attribute and no active element (script, iframe, object, embed, form, style, meta, svg, math, base, link) appeared in the output at any step. partial: nothing ran, but such an element or attribute is in the DOM. fail: a payload called the sentinel, or a dialog opened. Elements the library draws as its own chrome are subtracted with a plain-text control run.

title: Dangerous link schemes
oracle: Static scan of every resolved a.href protocol at every step, plus a real click on every link after the stream ends (target removed first). pass: all inert. partial: no javascript: link, but a data: or vbscript: href was kept. fail: a javascript: href exists, or a click ran script. A javascript: href that React replaced by its throwing stub counts as blocked.

title: Remote request from raw HTML
oracle: pass: no request left the page without a click. fail: any request to evil.test, at any step.

title: Remote request from a markdown image
oracle: pass: no request without a click (nothing rendered, or a click-to-load placeholder). fail: any request to evil.test, at any step (a half-typed URL counts).

title: Link target and rel
oracle: Diagnostic only. pass: the link has no target, or target=_blank with noopener. partial: target=_blank without rel noopener. Streamdown draws links as buttons, which has no anchor to inspect.

title: Raw markdown markers while streaming
oracle: Ten short documents, one construct each, written with letters only, so the final text contains none of * _ ` ~ # [ ] | > -. Each is streamed one character at a time. A construct leaks if any of those characters is in the container text after any write. A construct whose final text still has a marker was not rendered by the library at all, and counts as n/a, not as a leak. pass: 0 leaks. partial: 1 to 3. fail: 4 or more. The thresholds are provisional, the raw counts are the result. Marked and react-markdown are not streaming-aware, so the result says how they behave when used as documented.

title: CommonMark 0.31.2 conformance
oracle: All 652 examples of the spec, each written in one write, ended, and compared with the expected HTML after the same lenient normaliser for every library (tag structure plus whitespace-collapsed text, attributes ignored). Library-specific normaliser rules are listed in canon.mjs. The denominator is 652 for every library. Also recorded: a strict count (serialised HTML equal with whitespace between tags removed) and a text-only count. Informational, not a pass or fail.
